per_object_cap.stated: Six sandbox sizes: Nano 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB, Mini 1 / 2, Small 2 / 4, Medium 4 / 8, Large 8 / 16 and Big 16 / 32 GB; per-hour rates from USD 0.00405 to USD 0.1296.
per_object_cap.notes: 'They use the same CPU, memory and storage rates as other resources and count toward the $19 of included usage.'

interface_detail: REST API and CLI; sandbox create takes a millisecond lifetime

limits_note: Trial runs 1 Small, 2 Mini and 2 Nano sandboxes at once and deletes each sandbox 1 hour after it starts at the latest; the USD 19 credit is below a full month of the Medium sandbox.
reliability_note: When the credit is spent, running apps, databases and Sandboxes pause and no new ones can be created; the data is kept.

retention.stated: A paused sandbox and each snapshot cost USD 0.14 per GB-month of used disk space; Persistent Volumes bill while data is kept.
